method: Actual rendered frames, three distinct façade patches, six real camera distances, fixed sun/weather/profile/player/shadow origin. Lens FOV compensates distance to keep the same 24 cm world patch and pixel footprint, isolating distance-based material fade from texture minification; all FOVs recorded. Diagnostic camera inspections, not a walking route. Linear sRGB luminance measured from native WebGL pixels. No image edits.
